GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

4. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   C. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   C. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

14. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   B. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   D. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   B. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   C. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
